landing.hero_badge: Experience German! Vivez la langue allemande!
landing.hero_desc: Your language partner for German in Antananarivo. Structured courses from A1 to B2 with experienced teachers from Madagascar and Germany.
landing.feature1_desc: Learn with lecturers from the University of Madagascar and native-speaking teachers from Germany.
landing.feature2_desc: From basics to intermediate. Evening courses for professionals and holiday workshops for youths.
landing.feature3_desc: We prepare you linguistically for your stay in Germany and support you with visa questions.
landing.contact_desc: Write us a direct message. Our team will get back to you immediately to support you on your way to Germany.
landing.form_step1_desc: So we know who we're talking to.
landing.form_step2_desc: We only use this to reply to you.
landing.form_step3_desc: Ask us your questions about courses or visas.
landing.form_step4_desc2: . We have received your message and will get back to you shortly.
landing.footer_desc: Your language partner for German. Experience the German language directly in Antananarivo, Madagascar.
